metadata.title: What Is Medhavy?
metadata.note: 3-minute concept/vision overview. Narration is preserved from the supplied script and divided into production beats. Scenes describing AI co-instructor and course-creation capabilities are flagged as vision/roadmap in the supplied production notes; add a Coming Soon badge if required by technical review.
metadata.tts_note: Narration text normalized to plain ASCII to avoid punctuation encoding artifacts. Generate with --speed 0.9 for speech 10% slower than the default.
metadata.series_visual_language: Warm paper/ivory background, academic ink, Medhavy teal with restrained gold accents, chapter markers, highlighted passages, margin notes, page-based transitions, tutor panels, diagrammatic motion, and a new visual idea every 3-5 seconds.

beats.narration_text: What if your textbook could actually teach you? Not just let you search through pages. Not just answer any random question. But actually tutor you, personally, on exactly what you're learning. That's the idea behind Maydhaavy.

props.visualBrief: Five-stage hook: open textbook; generic chatbot appears; contrast/question; 'what if they worked together?'; tutor docks into the textbook and resolves to Medhavy.

beats.narration_text: Maydhaavy is an AI-powered learning platform built around interactive textbooks, with an AI tutor embedded directly into the learning experience.

props.visualBrief: Living textbook spread. Highlight a passage, then slide an embedded tutor panel out from the page margin so the tutor visibly belongs to the textbook.

beats.narration_text: The idea is simple. One login gives students access to the books they're allowed to use. Right now, those include physics, cancer biology, quantum mechanics, and electron microscopy. Instead of treating the textbook, the tutor, and the learning tools as separate things, Maydhaavy brings them together into one learning environment.

props.visualBrief: Sign in once; reveal Medhavy hub; four subject books appear sequentially; end by collapsing textbook, tutor, and learning tools into one connected environment.

beats.narration_text: Students can already ask a generic AI chatbot almost anything. But that's also the problem. A general chatbot can pull from a huge range of information, and its answer isn't necessarily connected to what the student is actually supposed to be learning.

props.visualBrief: Show a generic AI answering unrelated categories; expand to a large scattered knowledge space; introduce a warning; end on 'the answer may not match the course.'

beats.narration_text: Maydhaavy's tutor works differently. It pulls its answers from the content of the specific textbook the student is using. So if you're working through a chapter and something doesn't make sense, the tutor stays connected to that material. The goal isn't simply to give you an answer. It's to help you understand the material you're actually studying.

props.visualBrief: Open a chapter; highlight the exact passage; add a student question as a margin annotation; tutor response appears; finish with a visible source trace back to the highlighted chapter.

beats.narration_text: And not every student needs the same explanation. One student may understand something immediately after seeing a visual. Another may need to work through the idea step-by-step. Someone else may understand it best when they're asked the right question and guided toward the answer.

props.visualBrief: Cycle through three distinct teaching modes rather than showing them at once: visual diagram, step-by-step reasoning, then guiding question.

beats.narration_text: Maydhaavy is designed to remember those interactions and build a learner profile over time. As students read, ask questions, and work through material, the tutor can develop a better picture of how they learn and where they may need more support. Instead of giving everyone the exact same tutoring experience, the experience can adapt to the learner.

props.visualBrief: Student interactions accumulate one by one; they form a learner profile; preference bars resolve; the tutor changes its next explanation based on the profile.

beats.narration_text: But Maydhaavy isn't designed only for students. The same learning environment can support instructors as well.

props.visualBrief: Visually hand off from the student view to the instructor workspace, preserving the same page-based visual world.

beats.narration_text: Instructors already have a huge amount of course knowledge in their textbooks, lecture notes, and other course materials. Maydhaavy is designed to help them make more use of that content. Course material can be used to generate things like summaries, quizzes, exams, and lecture-notes. The idea is an AI co-instructor that helps reduce repetitive preparation work while keeping the instructor at the center of the course.

props.visualBrief: Four-stage instructor story: course materials appear; flow into AI co-instructor; outputs appear one by one; finish with instructor remaining in control. Show vision badge if needed.
props.badge: Coming Soon / Vision - use if technical review requires it

beats.narration_text: Because building a course from scratch takes time. Organizing material, creating modules, writing assessments, and preparing supporting resources can add hours of work before a student even enters the classroom.

props.visualBrief: Instructor tasks accumulate; timeline stretches; clock advances; visual pressure increases as prep work stacks up.

beats.narration_text: Maydhaavy is designed to make that process easier too. Material can come directly from a textbook or even a GitHub repository, and then be organized into course modules with generated assessments. Instead of rebuilding everything manually, instructors can start with the material they already have and turn it into a structured learning experience much faster.

props.visualBrief: Textbook + GitHub repository appear as inputs; pass through a structured Medhavy course-builder sequence; output modules and assessments. Show vision badge if needed.
props.badge: Coming Soon / Vision - use if technical review requires it

beats.narration_text: So what does this actually look like for a student? They log in once and see the textbooks available to them. They open a book, choose what they want to study, and start reading just like they would in a normal digital textbook. The difference is that the learning tools are right there with the content.

shot.visualBrief: Real Medhavy screen recording preferred: login to book selection to open a chapter to begin reading. If unavailable, use a clearly labeled UI mockup.

beats.narration_text: If something doesn't make sense, the student doesn't have to leave the book, open another tool, and explain all the context again. They can ask the tutor while they're learning. And instead of always jumping straight to the final answer, the tutor can nudge them with hints, explanations, and questions, more like a human tutor guiding someone through a difficult idea.

shot.visualBrief: Real product capture preferred: student opens tutor from a chapter, asks a question, and receives a hint or guiding question rather than only a final answer.

beats.narration_text: And the textbook itself is interactive! In Maydhaavy's textbooks, for example, students can interact with simulations directly on the page. Instead of only reading about an idea, they can explore it and see how changing something affects what happens.

shot.visualBrief: Screen capture of an actual interactive quantum simulation embedded in the textbook page. Show one meaningful interaction and visible response.

beats.narration_text: So the idea is simple. An interactive textbook that teaches back. Personalized, grounded, and built to make learning and teaching easier for everyone involved.

props.visualBrief: Return to the central living textbook from the opening. Lock in Personalized, Grounded, and Built for learning as three final principles.
Use the existing Medhavy outro as the recurring playlist end card.
